title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,351–2,400 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 高等教育；大學與研究所教育

examples.en: Taiwan's higher education system emphasizes science, technology, and engineering.
examples.zh: 台灣的高等教育體系格外重視理工與工程領域。

examples.en: Many governments offer grants to make higher education accessible to low-income families.
examples.zh: 許多國家政府提供專案補助，使低收入家庭學子也能享有接受高等教育的機會。

examples.en: Globalization has prompted universities to adapt their higher education programs to international standards.
examples.zh: 全球化浪潮促使各大專院校調整其高等教育課程體系以接軌國際標準。

examples.en: National Taiwan University's main campus is lined with majestic royal palms.
examples.zh: 國立台灣大學校總區椰林大道兩側種植著高聳壯觀的大王椰子樹。

examples.en: Free high-speed Wi-Fi covers every corner of the university campus.
examples.zh: 免費的高速無線網路全面覆蓋了整座大學校園的每一個角落。

examples.en: Students love hanging out on the green lawn in the center of the campus.
examples.zh: 學生們課餘時間最喜歡聚在大學校園中央的綠油油大草坪上聊天休憩。

examples.en: Undergraduate students complete four years of coursework to graduate.
examples.zh: 大學部學生需修滿四年的規定課程方可順利畢業。

examples.en: She works as an undergraduate research assistant in the chemistry laboratory.
examples.zh: 她在化學實驗室擔任大學部專題研究助理。

examples.en: The university offers career mentorship programs exclusively for undergraduate freshmen.
examples.zh: 該大學特別為大學部大一新鮮人量身打造了職涯導師諮詢輔導專案。

words.definition: 研究生；碩博士生；研究所的

examples.en: Postgraduate researchers conducted advanced clinical trials in the lab.
examples.zh: 研究所碩博士生在實驗室內進行了高階臨床試驗。

examples.en: After working in finance for three years, he applied for postgraduate studies in London.
examples.zh: 在金融界工作三年後，他毅然申請前往倫敦攻讀研究所課程。

examples.en: The department provides generous stipends for full-time postgraduate students.
examples.zh: 該學系為全職研究生提供了優渥的生活獎助學金。

examples.en: She earned a master's degree in computer science from Tsing Hua University.
examples.zh: 她榮獲了國立清華大學資訊工程學系的碩士學位。

examples.en: Having a master's degree can improve your starting salary in multinational corporations.
examples.zh: 擁有碩士學位資歷能大幅提升你在跨國外商企業中的起薪待遇。

examples.en: He decided to pursue a professional master's degree in business administration.
examples.zh: 他決定報考攻讀在職專班的企業管理碩士學位（MBA）。

examples.en: He spent five years of rigorous academic research earning his doctorate.
examples.zh: 他歷經五年嚴謹專注的學術研究後順利取得博士學位。

examples.en: Candidates defending their doctorate must demonstrate original contributions to their field.
examples.zh: 參加博士學位論文答辯的候選人必須證明自己對該學術領域具有原創性貢獻。

examples.en: Upon completing her doctorate, she was offered an assistant professorship.
examples.zh: 順利完成博士學位學程後，她立即獲得了大學助理教授的聘書。

examples.en: She was awarded a prestigious full government scholarship to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她榮獲了公費留學全額獎學金前往海外深造。

examples.en: Applicants must maintain top academic grades to retain their merit scholarship.
examples.zh: 申請人必須持續保持頂尖的學業成績以維持其優秀學生獎學金資格。

examples.en: The foundation established a memorial scholarship to honor the pioneering scientist.
examples.zh: 該基金會設立了一項紀念獎學金，以表彰這位先驅科學家的卓越貢獻。

words.definition: 大學學費；學雜費；個別指導

examples.en: Public university tuition in Taiwan is highly subsidized and affordable.
examples.zh: 台灣公立國立大學的學雜費享有政府高度補助，收費十分親民合理。

examples.en: Many American students take out substantial student loans to cover college tuition.
examples.zh: 許多美國大學生背負著高額的就學貸款以支付昂貴的大學學費。

examples.en: The private school announced a five percent increase in annual tuition fees.
examples.zh: 該所私立學校宣布將下一學年度的學費調漲百分之五。

words.definition: 入學許可；錄取資格；入場費

examples.en: He received an official admission letter from his dream university.
examples.zh: 他收到了來自他心目中第一志願大學的正式入學錄取通知書。

examples.en: University admission requirements include language proficiency test scores and essays.
examples.zh: 大學入學申請資格條件涵蓋外語能力檢定成績與個人陳述自傳。

examples.en: Museum admission is free for children under the age of six.
examples.zh: 六歲以下幼童可享免費入館參觀的免門票入場優惠。

examples.en: High school seniors prepare intensively for the national college entrance exam.
examples.zh: 高三應屆畢業生全力以赴準備大學學科能力測驗（學測）。

examples.en: Cram schools are packed with students drilling practice questions for the entrance exam.
examples.zh: 升學補習班擠滿了為了各類入學大考夜以繼日狂刷歷屆模擬題的學子。

examples.en: Passing the medical school entrance exam requires exceptional dedication and discipline.
examples.zh: 通過醫學院入學特考需要付出異於常人的專注力與高度自律。

examples.en: I plan to major in electrical engineering and minor in foreign languages.
examples.zh: 我計畫主修電機工程學系，並輔修外國語文學系。

examples.en: She decided to major in psychology because she wants to become a child counselor.
examples.zh: 她決定主修心理學，因為她的志願是成為一名兒童心理諮商師。

examples.en: Students who major in computer science are in high demand in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 主修資訊工程與電腦科學的畢業生在科技產業中炙手可熱。

examples.en: Minoring in business management complements her main design major nicely.
examples.zh: 輔修企業管理學系與她原本的主修設計學系形成了良好的互補。

examples.en: He chose to minor in Japanese to boost his chances of working in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 他選擇輔修日語學程，以增加日後前往東京外派就業的競爭優勢。

examples.en: You need twenty additional credits to complete an academic minor in mathematics.
examples.zh: 你需要額外修滿二十個學分才能達到取得數學輔系資格的要求。

examples.en: The Department of Foreign Languages hosts an annual English drama festival.
examples.zh: 外國語文學系每年都會盛大舉辦英語戲劇公演活動。

examples.en: She transferred from the chemistry department to life sciences during her sophomore year.
examples.zh: 她在大二那年順利從化學系轉系至生命科學系就讀。

examples.en: The sales department achieved record-breaking revenue figures this quarter.
examples.zh: 業務部門在這一季度繳出了打破歷史紀錄的亮眼營收業績。

words.definition: 全體教職員；學院；教學才能

examples.en: The university boasts world-renowned faculty members across all sciences.
examples.zh: 該大學在各自然科學領域均擁有享譽國際的頂尖師資陣容。

examples.en: The dean held a meeting with the law faculty to discuss curriculum changes.
examples.zh: 法學院院長與全體法學教職員召開研討會議，深入討論課程教學改革。

examples.en: In his old age, his sharp memory and reasoning faculties remained intact.
examples.zh: 儘管年事已高，他敏銳過人的記憶力與思維推理能力依舊絲毫未減。

examples.en: The professor encouraged active class participation and critical debate.
examples.zh: 這位教授大力鼓勵學生課堂主動發言與進行批判性思辨。

examples.en: The distinguished physics professor won the Nobel Prize for her research.
examples.zh: 這位傑出的物理學榮譽教授因其先驅研究榮獲了諾貝爾獎。

examples.en: Students lined up outside the professor's office during weekly consultation hours.
examples.zh: 學生們在每週固定的課後諮詢時間於教授研究室門外大排長龍。

words.definition: 大堂授課；專題演講；講課

examples.en: Over two hundred students attended the guest professor's economics lecture.
examples.zh: 超過兩百名學生出席聆聽了客座教授所主講的經濟學專題講座。

examples.en: The lecturer used multimedia slides and real-life case studies during the lecture.
examples.zh: 講師在課堂大堂授課過程中靈活運用多媒體投影片與生動的真實案例。

examples.en: My parents gave me a stern lecture about managing my personal finances wisely.
examples.zh: 父母親嚴肅地訓誡了我一番，告誡我必須明智且審慎地管理個人金錢財務。

words.definition: 專題研討會；小組討論課

examples.en: Graduate seminars foster in-depth academic discussions among small groups.
examples.zh: 研究所專題研討會促進了小組成員之間深度的學術交流與研討。

examples.en: The medical school hosted an international seminar on pediatric cardiology.
examples.zh: 該醫學院主辦了一場聚焦小兒心臟醫學前沿的跨國專題研討會。

examples.en: Each participant presented a research topic during the weekly literature seminar.
examples.zh: 每位參會學員在每週的文獻專題研討課上都要輪流發表研究專題。

examples.en: You need to earn at least 128 academic credits to fulfill degree requirements.
examples.zh: 您需要修滿至少 128 個學分方能符合畢業學位要求。

examples.en: The project's success was largely due to her team's relentless effort, and she deserves full credit.
examples.zh: 該專案的圓滿成功主要歸功於她團隊的全力以赴，她理應獲得最大的讚許與肯定。

examples.en: Customers can choose to pay by credit card or mobile wallet at checkout.
examples.zh: 顧客在結帳時可自由選擇使用信用卡刷卡或行動支付錢包付款。

words.definition: 課程教學大綱；課程進度表

examples.en: The professor handed out the course syllabus detailing grading policies.
examples.zh: 教授在第一堂課發放了詳列評分標準的課程教學大綱。

examples.en: Check the syllabus to find out the deadlines for all semester assignments.
examples.zh: 請查閱課程教學進度大綱，以確切掌握本學期所有作業的繳交截止期限。

examples.en: Reading lists and weekly lecture topics are outlined clearly in the syllabus.
examples.zh: 指定閱讀書單與每週授課主題均在教學大綱中條列得一清二楚。

words.definition: 先修科目；先決條件；先修的

examples.en: Calculus I is a mandatory prerequisite course for Advanced Physics.
examples.zh: 微積分（一）是選修高等物理學的必修先修科目。

examples.en: Fluent conversational English is an essential prerequisite for this overseas position.
examples.zh: 流利的英語口語溝通表達能力是應聘這項海外職缺不可或缺的必備先決條件。

examples.en: The academic portal prevented him from enrolling because he lacked the prerequisite.
examples.zh: 由於尚未修畢先修課程，校務選課系統自動限制了他選修該進階課的權限。

examples.en: Taking artistic elective courses helps develop creative aesthetic sensibilities.
examples.zh: 選修藝術通識選修課程有助於培養創意的審美素養。

examples.en: College students enjoy the freedom of choosing fascinating general education electives.
examples.zh: 大學生享有自由挑選自己感興趣的多元通識選修課程的彈性空間。

examples.en: He decided to undergo an elective cosmetic surgery procedure during the summer.
examples.zh: 他決定利用暑假空檔接受一項非緊急且自主選擇的醫美微整形手術。

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory required subject for all incoming students.
examples.zh: 大一英文是全體大一新生必須共同修習的必修科目。

examples.en: Basic military training is compulsory for eligible male citizens in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，役男公民依法接受基礎軍事常規訓練是法定的義務義務。

examples.en: Wearing safety hard hats is compulsory at all construction worksites.
examples.zh: 在所有建築工地施工現場，所有人皆一律強制佩戴安全帽。

words.definition: 歷年成績單；文字逐字稿

examples.en: Submit your official certified high school transcript along with the application.
examples.zh: 提出申請時，請檢附由學校官方認證蓋章的歷年成績單。

examples.en: The court reporter prepared a verbatim transcript of the trial proceedings.
examples.zh: 法庭書記官迅速整理出了該次庭審訴訟過程的一字不差完整逐字稿。

examples.en: Graduate schools request sealed academic transcripts sent directly from registrars.
examples.zh: 研究所申請通常要求由畢業學校註冊組直接寄出密封認證的歷年成績單。

words.definition: 學業平均成績 (Grade Point Average)

examples.en: Maintaining a high cumulative GPA opens doors for overseas study exchange.
examples.zh: 維持優異的累積 GPA 平均成績能為爭取海外交換學生敞開大門。

examples.en: Top investment banks set strict minimum GPA requirements for summer internships.
examples.zh: 頂尖華爾街投資銀行對暑期實習申請者設有極為嚴格的最低 GPA 成績門檻。

examples.en: She raised her semester GPA to 3.9 through disciplined study habits.
examples.zh: 她憑藉著高度自律的苦讀學習習慣，將該學期 GPA 平均績點大幅拉升至 3.9。

examples.en: The fall academic semester runs from mid-September through mid-January.
examples.zh: 大學秋季學期從九月中旬一路進行至隔年一月中旬。

examples.en: Students cram for exams during the stressful final week of each semester.
examples.zh: 學生們在每學期壓力最沉重的期末週期間熬夜臨時抱佛腳苦讀迎考。

examples.en: She plans to take eighteen credits next semester to graduate one term early.
examples.zh: 她打算下學期多修十八個學分，爭取提早一個學期順利自大學畢業。

words.definition: 碩士論文；畢業論文；論點

examples.en: Graduate students spent months writing their master's research thesis.
examples.zh: 碩士研究生耗費數月心血撰寫他們的碩士學位研究論文。

examples.en: The main thesis of her essay argues that green energy fuels sustainable economic growth.
examples.zh: 她這篇論述文的核心論點主張發展綠色潔淨能源是永續經濟增長的強大引擎。

examples.en: He spent endless nights in the library analyzing laboratory data for his thesis.
examples.zh: 他在大學圖書館裡度過了無數個漫漫長夜，只為替畢業論文嚴密分析實驗數據。

examples.en: Defending a doctoral dissertation is the final milestone before graduation.
examples.zh: 博士論文答辯口試是順利畢業取得學位前的最後一項重要里程碑。

examples.en: Her 300-page doctoral dissertation focused on Taiwanese semiconductor history.
examples.zh: 她長達三百頁的厚重博士論文專門聚焦於台灣半導體產業發展史。

examples.en: The academic committee thoroughly questioned the methodologies used in the dissertation.
examples.zh: 學術口試委員針對該博士論文中所採用的研究方法論進行了層層深入盤問。

words.definition: 指導教授；學術導師；顧問

examples.en: Meet with your thesis advisor regularly to discuss experimental methodologies.
examples.zh: 定期與您的論文指導教授會面以討論實驗研究方法論。

examples.en: The foreign policy advisor briefed the president prior to the international summit.
examples.zh: 在跨國高峰會召開之前，外交政策資深顧問向總統進行了全面的機密簡報。

examples.en: A trusted financial advisor helps families plan retirement and minimize tax liabilities.
examples.zh: 值得信賴的專業理財顧問協助廣大家庭規劃退休金並合法達到節稅效益。

examples.en: Students collaborated on a research paper regarding microplastic pollution.
examples.zh: 學生們通力合作撰寫了一篇關於塑膠微粒海洋污染的學術研究論文。

examples.en: Writing a comprehensive literature review is the first step of a research paper.
examples.zh: 撰寫嚴謹的文獻探討回顧是著手展開任何學術研究論文寫作的起手式。

examples.en: The professor praised the research paper for its thorough methodology and lucid writing.
examples.zh: 教授高度讚賞該篇學術研究論文結構方法嚴密且文字邏輯清晰流暢。

examples.en: Their breakthrough discovery was published in a prestigious international academic journal.
examples.zh: 他們的突破性研究發現發表在國際頂尖的知名學術期刊上。

examples.en: University libraries subscribe to thousands of digital academic journals for student research.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館採購訂閱了數以千計的數位電子學術期刊以供全校師生檢索研究。

examples.en: Publishing original work in an academic journal enhances a scholar's career reputation.
examples.zh: 在權威學術期刊上公開發表原創研究成果，能顯著提升學者在學術界的聲望。

examples.en: Scientific articles undergo rigorous double-blind peer review before publication.
examples.zh: 科學論文在正式發表前皆需通過嚴格的雙盲同儕審查機制。

examples.en: Honest peer review ensures that only valid, high-quality research is disseminated.
examples.zh: 客觀公正的同儕審查機制確保只有經得起檢驗的高品質研究成果得以傳播發表。

examples.en: The researchers revised their statistical calculations following suggestions from peer review.
examples.zh: 研究團隊在收到同儕評審委員的反饋建議後，認真修正了論文中的統計推導算式。

words.definition: 出版物；發表作品；學術發表

examples.en: The professor has over fifty scholarly publications in international journals.
examples.zh: 該教授在各大國際權威期刊上發表了五十餘篇學術研究論著。

examples.en: The date of the book's official publication was pushed back by two months.
examples.zh: 這本備受矚目的新書正式公開出版發行的日期被往後推遲了兩個月。

examples.en: Scientific publications require accurate documentation of all experimental data sources.
examples.zh: 科學研究發表成果要求必須對所有實驗數據的來源與出處進行精確記載。

examples.en: Format all academic citations accurately using APA or MLA citation styles.
examples.zh: 請使用 APA 或 MLA 格式標準準確標註所有文獻引用出處。

examples.en: High citation counts reflect the wide influence of a published paper in its discipline.
examples.zh: 高文獻被引用次數客觀反映了已發表論文在該學術領域中的深遠影響力。

examples.en: The heroic firefighter received a formal city citation for braving the flames.
examples.zh: 這位奮不顧身闖入火場英勇救人的消防隊員榮獲了市政府頒發的正式嘉獎表彰。

examples.en: Attach a complete alphabetical bibliography at the end of your essay.
examples.zh: 在論文報告文末請按字母順序附上完整的參考文獻書目清單。

examples.en: The author spent months assembling a comprehensive historical bibliography.
examples.zh: 作者耗費數月時間精心彙編了一份內容詳實的歷史主題專題參考書目。

examples.en: Software reference managers format bibliographies automatically to match journal guidelines.
examples.zh: 文獻管理軟體工具能自動排版參考文獻清單，以完全契合各期刊的投稿規範。

examples.en: Academic plagiarism is strictly forbidden and results in disciplinary penalty.
examples.zh: 學術抄襲剽竊行為在校園內是嚴格禁止的，違者將面臨重大處分。

examples.en: Universities deploy sophisticated software to check student submissions for plagiarism.
examples.zh: 各大學均普遍導入先進的文本比對查重系統，以嚴格審查學生報告是否有抄襲嫌疑。

examples.en: Always paraphrase ideas properly and credit the original author to avoid plagiarism.
examples.zh: 務必用自己的文字妥善改寫觀點並註明原作者出處，以防觸犯學術抄襲。

examples.en: Chemistry students conducted a colorful titration laboratory experiment.
examples.zh: 化學系學生在實驗室進行了一場色彩斑斕的酸鹼滴定實驗。

examples.en: The startup decided to experiment with a four-day workweek model.
examples.zh: 這家創新新創團隊決定大膽試驗推行每週四天工作制的新營運模式。

examples.en: Careful control variables are crucial for obtaining reproducible results in any experiment.
examples.zh: 嚴格控制各項控制變數是確保任何科學實驗皆能產出可重複驗證成果的關鍵。

examples.en: Wear protective safety goggles and white coats inside the science laboratory.
examples.zh: 進入科學實驗室內請務必穿著防護白袍並佩戴護目鏡。

examples.en: The pharmaceutical company built an advanced biosafety laboratory to study infectious viruses.
examples.zh: 這家跨國製藥大廠斥資建造了高規格生物安全實驗室以深入研究高致病性病毒。

examples.en: Test results from the medical laboratory confirmed that the patient had recovered.
examples.zh: 醫事檢驗實驗室出具的化驗報告證實該名患者各項數值恢復正常、已然康復。

examples.en: Formulate a testable scientific hypothesis before beginning experiments.
examples.zh: 在著手展開各項實驗之前，先建立一個可被驗證的科學假說。

examples.en: The experimental data gathered from trials strongly supported our original hypothesis.
examples.zh: 臨床試驗中所蒐集到的各項實驗數據強烈佐證支持了我們最初設定的科學假說。

examples.en: Scientists rejected the preliminary hypothesis when new planetary evidence emerged.
examples.zh: 當全新的行星探測實證數據出爐後，天文科學家們推翻了先前的初步假說。

examples.en: The research methodology section describes data gathering tools clearly.
examples.zh: 論文的方法論章節清楚詳述了數據資料收集的各項研究工具。

examples.en: Critics questioned whether the sampling methodology used in the poll was biased.
examples.zh: 評論家們提出質疑，認為該民意調查中所採用的抽樣方法論是否存在偏誤。

examples.en: Adopting an agile project management methodology improved development velocity.
examples.zh: 團隊全面導入敏捷專案管理方法論後，顯著提升了軟體開發與產品交付效率。

words.definition: 實證的；經驗主義的；實驗依據的

examples.en: Theories must be supported by empirical data gathered from real-world observations.
examples.zh: 理論推導必須獲得來自真實世界觀察所得的實證數據支持。

examples.en: The economist presented compelling empirical evidence linking tax cuts to job growth.
examples.zh: 經濟學家提出了極具說服力的實證研究數據，論證了減稅與就業成長間的直接關聯。

examples.en: Relying on empirical research is far more dependable than trusting mere intuition.
examples.zh: 仰賴科學實證研究遠比單純盲信個人主觀直覺要可靠得多。

words.definition: 數量的；量化的；定量分析的

examples.en: Quantitative research analyzes numerical data using statistical software.
examples.zh: 量化研究運用統計分析軟體對數值數據進行深度演算分析。

examples.en: The market survey generated rich quantitative figures on weekly spending.
examples.zh: 這項市場調查收集到了關於消費者每週支出金額的豐富量化數據資料。

examples.en: Researchers combined quantitative survey results with open-ended feedback.
examples.zh: 研究人員將量化調查問卷統計結果與開放式質性回饋進行了深入對照分析。

words.definition: 質化的；定性的；品質上的

examples.en: Qualitative research gathers rich insights through in-depth personal interviews.
examples.zh: 質化研究透過深度個別訪談來蒐集豐富細膩的質性觀點。

examples.en: Focus groups provide valuable qualitative data on how shoppers perceive new packaging.
examples.zh: 焦點訪談小組為了解消費者對新外包裝設計的心理感受提供了極佳的質性數據。

examples.en: There has been a discernible qualitative improvement in the school's teaching standards.
examples.zh: 該校的整體師資教學水準在近年來出現了肉眼可見的實質品質提升。

examples.en: Distribute the online survey questionnaire to collect consumer responses.
examples.zh: 發送線上調查問卷以廣泛蒐集消費者的真實回饋意見。

examples.en: Please take five minutes to fill out our customer satisfaction questionnaire.
examples.zh: 請耽誤您五分鐘的寶貴時間，協助填寫這份顧客服務滿意度調查問卷。

examples.en: The researchers carefully designed each question on the survey questionnaire to avoid bias.
examples.zh: 研究人員字斟句酌地精心設計調查問卷上的每道題目，以極力避免引導性偏見。

examples.en: A large and diverse sample size ensures statistical accuracy and reliability.
examples.zh: 龐大且多元的樣本規模能確保統計推論的精準度與信度。

examples.en: With a sample size of only ten participants, the survey results cannot be generalized.
examples.zh: 在受訪樣本數僅有十位參與者的情況下，該調查所得結論無法被普遍推論推廣。

examples.en: Increasing the trial sample size reduced the statistical margin of error.
examples.zh: 擴大臨床實驗的抽樣樣本數顯著縮小了統計運算時的抽樣誤差範圍。

examples.en: Studies show a positive correlation between aerobic exercise and memory retention.
examples.zh: 多項研究顯示有氧運動與記憶力保持之間存在著正向相關性。

examples.en: Scientists emphasize that statistical correlation does not necessarily imply direct causation.
examples.zh: 科學界再三強調，統計學上的數據相關性並不必然等同於直接因果關係。

examples.en: Researchers discovered an inverse correlation between sleep deprivation and work productivity.
examples.zh: 研究人員敏銳地發現，睡眠剝奪程度與白天工作生產力之間存在著顯著負相關。

examples.en: Many foreign exchange students fall in love with Taiwanese night markets.
examples.zh: 許多外籍國際交換學生都深深愛上了台灣熱鬧溫馨的夜市文化。

examples.en: She spent a rewarding semester as an exchange student at a university in Kyoto.
examples.zh: 她以國際交換學生的身分在京都一所知名大學度過了收穫滿滿的一個學期。

examples.en: The local host family organized a welcome barbecue for the visiting exchange student.
examples.zh: 當地接待家庭特地為剛抵達的交換學生舉辦了一場溫馨熱鬧的迎新烤肉派對。

examples.en: Studying abroad expands global horizons and fosters personal independence.
examples.zh: 出國留學深造能開拓寬廣的國際視野並培養獨立自主的生活能力。

examples.en: Many university students save money from part-time jobs to study abroad in Europe.
examples.zh: 許多大學生利用課餘兼職打工存錢，為日後前往歐洲留學深造做好準備。

examples.en: The university holds annual fairs to inform students about opportunities to study abroad.
examples.zh: 該大學每年舉辦留學博覽會，向在校生詳細介紹豐富多元的出國進修管道。

words.definition: 校友；畢業生們（單數 alumnus / alumna）

examples.en: Distinguished university alumni established an endowed scholarship fund.
examples.zh: 傑出的大學畢業校友們共同設立了專屬的永續留本獎學金。

examples.en: The university invites successful alumni back to campus to give career talks.
examples.zh: 學校經常邀請在社會各領域功成名就的校友返校向學弟妹分享職場心得。

examples.en: The annual alumni reunion banquet was held at the grand hotel ballroom.
examples.zh: 一年一度的大學校友校友重聚晚宴在五星級飯店的挑高宴會廳隆重登場。

words.definition: 畢業典禮；開始；學位授予儀式

examples.en: Graduates tossed their academic caps joyfully at the commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業生們在隆重熱鬧的畢業典禮上歡欣雀躍地拋起學士帽。

examples.en: The tech CEO delivered an inspiring keynote address at the university commencement.
examples.zh: 科技巨頭執行長在大專院校畢業典禮上發表了一場鼓舞人心的主題演講。

examples.en: The commencement of the high-speed rail project marked a new era in island transit.
examples.zh: 高速鐵路工程建設的正式動工開端，標誌著全島交通運輸邁向了全新的嶄新紀元。

examples.en: She proudly framed her bachelor's diploma and hung it on the wall.
examples.zh: 她自豪地將大學學士學位畢業證書裱框裝飾掛在牆面上。

examples.en: You must present your original high school diploma when registering for college.
examples.zh: 在辦理大學新生註冊入學手續時，必須出示高中畢業文憑正本。

examples.en: Earning a vocational diploma provided him with valuable practical culinary credentials.
examples.zh: 取得職業專科文憑證書為他投身專業西餐烹飪領域提供了極具分量的專業資歷。
